definitions.final_demand_twh: all loads of the country (energy carriers incl. useful heat, feedstock, H2, ammonia / methanol; bunkers in the regional pool excluded)
definitions.fixed_electricity_twh: base + industry electricity + agriculture machinery electric + land transport EV (S4R definition)
definitions.industry_heat_medium_a_b_twh: other-bucket (+ overflow) useful heat loads of the 150-200 C / 200-400 C buses (supplement 01); *_medium_twh = M08b first-round 150-400 C bus
definitions.residential_commercial_agriculture_fuel_: final-energy fuel rows (all non-electricity carriers) of the demand table the network was built from: old / m08b1 = ratio table (not anchored), new = ATS anchor table (supplement 01 section 3, negative anchors set to 0)
definitions.pv_cap_gw: sum of p_nom_max of the ground-mounted solar candidates
definitions.storage_cap_mt: annual national CO2 storage cap (co2 sequestered Store e_nom_max)
definitions.cement_and_steel_mt: 2050 physical output (old: ratio-table main INDUSTRY_2050_SUMMARY_aeo8_ats_relative.csv; new: ATS anchor + output rule)
